value.rationale: The new coefficient answers whether the quadratic comparison error in the current Paley–Wiener stability theorem is sharp. A natural symmetric endpoint exchange yields a positive, convergent resolvent constant and rules out any uniform little-oh strengthening. The optimizer-adaptation effect is invisible to the previously known leading detachment law, so it is a motivated, structural higher-order theorem, not a scalar reparametrization.
